failure_mechanism: The manifest-bound isolated Python cannot resolve the broker's sibling windows_install_manifest module because the broker executable lacks the script-directory and project-root sys.path bootstrap already used by the child controller.

direct_facts.claim: The failed broker first imports windows_install_manifest and then scripts.windows_install_manifest without bootstrapping either import root.
The failed candidate contains windows_install_manifest.py, so the module is packaged rather than absent.
The child controller explicitly inserts its script directory and project root into sys.path before sibling imports.
The broker replay failed at those imports and produced no child receipt.

alternative_causes_excluded: the manifest module was omitted from the candidate
the child controller launched and failed later
the original Inno entrypoint did not reach the transaction boundary
the replay used a different failed exit boundary

minimal_repair_boundary.required_change: Make the broker executable-script bootstrap equivalent to the existing child-controller bootstrap before sibling imports.
forbidden_expansion: weakened manifest, hash, SID, nonce, path, or runtime checks
